answer: Resist sybils with costly identity parentage: a new identity can only be born when an established agent sponsors it by permanently giving up a slice of its own reward rate, recorded in a public atlas of lineage. One child costs a sliver; the hundredth child leaves the parent earning almost nothing, like a relic stripped of its gold. A farmer's thousand clones would need a thousand parents or one parent bled dry, while an honest agent sponsors a single child and keeps its jade-bright standing.
